en: Sepia-toned postcard view showing a tall medieval brick tower with crenellations, identified as Torre Vanga, standing beside a broad open square. To the left runs a tree-lined canal or river with a path and railway tracks in the foreground, and mountains rising in the distant background. A few figures with umbrellas walk in the square near the tower. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom margin.
